answer: Stake-backed admission bond. Each new agent posts collateral before joining the courier pool, sized to the work it may route. Cheat by signing conflicting claims or passing off a relic of past service, and the bond is slashed and split among the peers who exposed you. Sybil swarms scale bonds linearly, so fifty fake identities cost fifty times the timber of one honest node. A whisper of doubt triggers audit, not gossip.
